content: ICAM practice uses PEEPO (People, Environment, Equipment, Procedures, Organisation) as an evidence-gathering checklist; TapRooT uses '3 Ps and an R' (people, paper, physical, recording), ABS uses people/paper/physical/position. Templates are institutional, no single authoritative ICAM evidence-log schema found. Chain of custody in digital forensics (ISO/IEC 27037) centres on identification, collection, acquisition, preservation, with SHA-256 hash verification and auditability/repeatability principles.
